claims.value: Aya Expanse 32B is an open-weight research release of a multilingual large language model with 32 billion parameters, developed by Cohere Labs. It supports 23 languages and uses an optimized transformer architecture with post-training including supervised finetuning, preference training, and model merging.
claims.evidence: Aya Expanse 32B is an open-weight research release of a model with highly advanced multilingual capabilities... The result is a powerful multilingual large language model serving 23 languages.
Input**: Models input text only. **Output**: Models generate text only.
Post-training includes supervised finetuning, preference training, and model merging.
